note: A copy of the `reservations` list (id, owner, hosts, from, until) in leo-workspace machines/fleet-registry.json (tools/fleet_reservations.py reads the same entries), with each reserved host's registry aliases. glaeda-disk and glaeda-fleet-cas-prune read it from ~/.local/share/glaeda/fleet-reservations.json: on a host an active entry names, only floor-pressure eviction runs, at the pre-2026-10-26 ages. An entry lapses by itself after `until`. Update it with the registry: scripts/test-glaeda-disk.py compares the two where the registry is checked out.
